Philosophy

We recognize Bitcoin is a direct challenge to nation state monetary sovereignty. It is a check on central bankers. It is our best chance to reboot the monetary system on sound money.

We see the demise of the dollar as a mathematical inevitability, no different than any other fiat currency that came before it. The dollar as we know it has only been that way since 1971. The global monetary order is broken. The only sensible solution is to build a voluntary shadow economic system that accelerates the inevitable. The demise of the dollar doesn't have to be a moment marked by chaos and violence. It can be a joyous moment, a debt jubilee. Bitcoin is the natural choice, but it's not without its flaws.

We must do the work to make it more secure, more private, more scalable, and work for us.
